Scholarships

Information and resources regarding scholarships and Ms. Thomas' scholarship list organized by deadline.

Scholarships are for seniors unless otherwise noted. Ms. Thomas will add scholarships as she learns about them, but this list is not extensive. You should continue to search for scholarships on your own.

Scholarship Timeline

Scholarships are available year-round. Below is an overview of what scholarships typically come out and when


  • August - December:

    • Mostly competitive, full-ride scholarships (ex. Gates, QuestBridge, Golden Door)

    • Institutional scholarships (from specific schools)

  • January - May:

    • Local CMS/Charlotte/Mecklenburg County scholarships

    • Your best bet for getting $$$. Do not overlook small scholarships because they add up and are more time efficient than working.

  • Don't give up just because you apply to many and don't receive any scholarships. You have to keep applying or you won't get any!

Searching for Scholarships

Be mindful of scams. You should not be paying anything to apply to scholarships. If you are unsure, ask! Here are some scholarship search engines:

  • https://www.chegg.com/scholarships

  • https://www.fastweb.com/

  • https://www.scholarships.com/

  • https://bigfuture.collegeboard.org/scholarship-search

  • https://www.cfnc.org/paying/schol/all_schols.jsp

  • https://www.nccommunityfoundation.org/apply/scholarships

  • https://www.fftc.org/scholarships

  • https://www.goingmerry.com/

  • https://www.raise.me/

Due in February

Florence Kidder Memorial Scholarship (Due Feb. 6, 2022)

DUE DATE:

Feb. 6

AWARD AMOUNT:

Six scholarships will be awarded in one year: First place - $3,000, second place - $1,000, third place - $800 and three fourth places - $400.

ELIGIBILITY:

Be a high school senior who is planning on beginning a postsecondary (college-level) program in North Carolina beginning in the fall of 2021.

APPLICATION REQUIRMENTS:

  • A completed application form answering all questions and supplying all requested documents.

  • A separate listing of extracurricular activities, honors, community work and work experience.

  • A current photograph.

  • An unofficial transcript of grades, including first semester senior courses if possible and current GPA.

  • A letter of recommendation from one of the student’s teachers (scanned and in pdf format).

  • Original essay of 500 to 700 words on this year’s topic.

WEBSITE:

https://www.ncdames.org/florence-kidder-memorial-scholarship

NCAE Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Scholarship (Due Feb. 7 2022)

DUE DATE:

First Monday in Feb. (Feb. 7 2022)

AWARD AMOUNT:

Determined based off application (distributed during fall and spring semesters of first year of college)

ELIGIBILITY:

  • NC resident

  • Enrolled in a public high school

  • Minimum overall unweighted GPA of 2.5 or higher

  • Criteria for selection

    • Character

    • Community involvement

    • Scholastic achievement

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Completed application form.

  • Resume of accomplishments, extra-curricular activities, scholarships, affiliations, and organizations.

  • Essays (one page or less, typed and double spaces using standard font style and size 12)

    • Please tell how the philosophies and ideals of Dr. King influence your life.

    • Why do you feel you deserve this scholarship and what is your need for financial assistance?

  • Official transcript embossed, signed and sealed.

  • Two letters of recommendation (signed and in a sealed envelope)

    • One recommendation from school personnel (on school letterhead).

    • One recommendation from a member of applicant's community.

WEBSITE:

https://www.ncae.org/mlkjrscholarshipinfo

Due in April

Presidential Scholarship - Central Piedmont Community College (Due April 1, 2022)

DUE DATE:

April 1

AWARD AMOUNT:

Tuition and fees for a maximum of two years (30 awards)

ELIGIBILITY:

  • Have an unweighted high school GPA of 3.0 or higher

  • Be committed to finishing an associate degree at CPCC

  • Maintain a minimum 3.0 GPA while at CPCC and stay continuously enrolled full-time (summer excluded)

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Apply to CPCC

  • Create your personal login and password (CPCC Login)

  • Complete the General Scholarship Application form on AcademicWorks

  • Apply to the Presidential Scholars program by clicking the “Apply To” button next to Presidential Scholars Program

    • Answer the following supplemental questions:

      • Why you are interested in attending Central Piedmont Community College?

      • How will your participation in the Presidential Scholars Program enhance your educational experience?

      • List, and explain, at least two contributions you feel you will add to the Presidential Scholars group.

  • Complete the FAFSA

  • Optional letter of recommendation

WEBSITE:

https://cpcc.academicworks.com/opportunities/6113
